scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan
other_conditions: Eligible micro, small or medium enterprises (MSMEs) operating in the powerloom sector.
Enterprises must have started production between 01‑01‑2022 and 31‑12‑2024.
A four‑party agreement must be executed with the Directorate of Textiles, the financial institution and Tantuja.
Units can be private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertakings, companies/undertakings owned and managed by the State Government, or industrial SHGs.
The project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose.
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subsidy on term loans for powerloom MSMEs – up to 70% of interest liability for micro/small enterprises (zone‑specific) and up to 25% for medium enterprises for five years, subject to a ceiling of ₹1.75 crore per year.
